where.if: and ( title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or author like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or publisher like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or isbn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or shelf_location like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.update: update book set available_qty = available_qty - 1 where id = #{id} and available_qty > 0 and status = 'ENABLED'
